data.narrative:
Iambic Therapeutics is a Series B biotech company founded by Tom Miller, Fred Manby, and Matthew Welborn that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular relevance to same-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two methods are applicable to this analysis. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $350M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $665M. The peer-median approach anchors to three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables with a median valuation of $3.8B (ranging from $3.1B to $10.3B). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple cannot be applied, as Iambic's revenue is not on file; the Biotech & Health public median P/S of 7.4x across the three public tickers is therefore not actionable.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $565M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.2B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage positioning relative to the peer set: the stage-progression method yields a more conservative $665M, while peer medians suggest substantially higher valuations. Resolution of this gap depends on clarification of Iambic's clinical progress, capital efficiency trajectory, and exact positioning within the Series B-to-Series C continuum.
